_about: Verified pick'em payout tables for the competitor-spec features (SCOUT_PICKEM_EV, SCOUT_BEST_SLIPS, SCOUT_SLIP_HEADER math). Read by gradecore.payouts.pickem_config(); the default gradecore.payouts.CONFIG (and every live caller of it) is untouched. Flex tables are keyed by LOSSES -> gross payout multiple (entry fee included). Standard lines only: goblin / demon / promo lines and same-game combinations can pay differently and stay unavailable unless their payout is supplied.

prizepicks.status: Verified from the PrizePicks help center (page dated 2026-10-19, read 2026-11-03 and again 2026-11-05); matches payout_reference.py and the Power / Flex all-hit tiers seen in-app on 2026-11-05 (spec section 3). PrizePicks states payouts can differ for promos, goblin / demon lines, same-game combinations and Team Pick; the in-app details screen is final.
caveats: DNPs and reboots reduce the pick count (lower multiplier)
ties can lower the payout one level
goblin / demon / promo / same-game lineups can pay differently
Flex 2-pick appears on the help center but not in the in-app view of 2026-11-05

underdog.status: Verified from the Underdog help center on 2026-10-23 (recorded in gradecore/payouts.py UD_*). A re-read on 2026-11-05 was refused by the site (HTTP 403) and was not worked around; the 2026-10-23 table stands.
caveats: how several pick modifiers combine is not published (payouts.MODIFIER_RULE is an assumption)
